$comment: Run O1 lane K1 which: the Which character are you quiz of Oshi no Ko, written by us, one quiz per series, arc 0. Facts cited per character: ai-hoshino: oshi-no-ko-ai-scouted-strawberry-043, oshi-no-ko-ai-bkomachi-centerpiece-044, oshi-no-ko-ai-hoshino-personality-054, oshi-no-ko-ai-hoshino-performs-affection-055; kana-arima: oshi-no-ko-kana-child-prodigy-019, oshi-no-ko-kana-arima-restrains-talent-056; akane-kurokawa: oshi-no-ko-akane-kurokawa-stage-actress-057, oshi-no-ko-akane-kurokawa-method-acting-058; taishi-gotanda: oshi-no-ko-taishi-gotanda-film-director-059, oshi-no-ko-taishi-gotanda-scouts-talent-060; ichigo-saito: oshi-no-ko-ichigo-strawberry-president-041, oshi-no-ko-ichigo-saito-recruits-ai-061; miyako-saito: oshi-no-ko-miyako-runs-agency-042, oshi-no-ko-miyako-saito-married-to-ichigo-062; melt-narushima: oshi-no-ko-melt-narushima-arrogant-start-063, oshi-no-ko-melt-narushima-humbled-064, oshi-no-ko-melt-narushima-improves-065. Every profile line rests on those verified facts and says nothing about a later arc.

questions.question: Your school is putting on a talent show next month. What is your move?

options.text: Sign up first and worry about the stage later
Watch other acts, take notes, and write a detailed plan
Run the sign-up table and make sure every act gets a slot
Find the shy friend with a hidden talent and talk them into it

questions.question: You are handed a brand new part to play. How do you prepare?

options.text: Study the character from every angle until I disappear into them
Trust my instincts and the skills I have always had
Charm the whole cast so the work feels easy for everyone
Panic a little, wing it, and get better in front of the crowd

questions.question: Someone you know is quietly brilliant at something. What do you do?

options.text: Tell them plainly what I see and push them to go further
Offer them a place on my team before anyone else does
Hold back a little so I do not steal their shine
Cheer louder than anyone and make them a banner

questions.question: Your plans fall apart an hour before the big day. You:

options.text: Rebalance the budget and fix it quietly in the background
Smile at everyone and carry the room through it
Admit I was overconfident, learn the lesson, and train harder
Make a bold new call and see who wants to follow

questions.question: How do you honestly feel about the spotlight?

options.text: I belong in it, and I have worked for it since I was little
I like it best when a whole team shares it with me
I would rather be in the wings making the show possible
I like standing behind the camera, framing it for someone else
Rehearsing alone in a quiet studio
A big fan meet where I get to talk with everybody
A tidy desk and a long list I actually finish
Out looking at small shows for someone worth betting on

questions.question: You get praised in front of a crowd. How does it land?

options.text: I enjoy every second and hope it does not go to my head
I say the praise is too generous, and I mean it
It goes straight to my head until the world corrects me
I thank them warmly and keep my real thoughts for later

questions.question: Your group is stuck on a big decision. You:

options.text: Say the blunt thing nobody wants to say
Lay out a careful plan with every step written down
Pick the bold option and bring the others along
Quietly handle the logistics so a decision becomes possible

profile: You light up a room for other people and put their feelings ahead of your own.
You are warm and attentive, though you keep some of your thoughts to yourself.
You started small, got noticed early, and learned to give a crowd what it needs.
You have been great at your craft since you were small, and everyone knows it.
You can bring up a feeling exactly when a moment needs it.
You sometimes hold back so you do not outshine the people beside you.
You prepare like a professional and study every part you take in depth.
You treat acting as a craft, and you pour yourself into each role.
You will happily take a stage that helps your troupe get noticed.
You have an eye for potential and cannot help pointing it out in people.
You like working behind the camera, directing a story for someone else.
You nudge people toward acting when you see what they could do.
You like leading a small team and betting on people before they are famous.
You are the one who spots a rising star and brings them on board.
You are the one who keeps the whole operation running behind the scenes.
You manage the business side and keep things afloat, and you work best as half of a team.
You walk in sure of yourself long before you have earned it.
You can be humbled, and then you quietly go and work on your skills.
